tasks.query: At https://www.ycombinator.com/, find all startups from the 2022 and 2023 Y Combinator batches that are headquartered in France and currently have open job postings.
At https://www.imdb.com/, search for the movies "No Other Choice" and "My Daughter is a Zombie" and tell me the difference in their ratings.
At https://google.com/maps/, find the highest-rated hotel suitable for 4 guests in Manhattan, New York, and tell me the fastest public-transit option from that hotel to LGA airport.
At https://www.google.com/maps/, find a gas station in Manhattan, NY with a rating above 4.0, and sort the user reviews by the lowest rating.
At https://store.steampowered.com/, check the most recent negative reviews from users with over 100 hours of playtime for the game that won the 2023 VR Game of the Year award.
At https://code.visualstudio.com/, find the keyboard shortcut to open the Command Palette in VS Code on macOS from the official documentation.
At https://www.python.org/, navigate to the changelog page for the most recent stable version of the Python programming language.
At https://www.imdb.com/, show the crazy credits for the movie "Prometheus".
At https://www.leagueoflegends.com/, browse the final skin in the list for the champion Ahri.
At https://arxiv.org/, search for reinforcement-learning papers under the Computer Science and Mathematics topics, by most recent submission date between September 2024 and January 2025.
At https://www.gov.kr/, go to the 'Welfare Services' tab and check the list of benefits related to 'Low-Income Support'.
At https://www.ups.com/, calculate the shipping cost for a 12x10x8 inch, 5-pound package sent via UPS Ground from New York, NY 10001 to Los Angeles, CA 90001.
At https://huggingface.co/models, filter for the Text Classification task and the Apache-2.0 license, sort by most downloads, and tell me the name and download count of the top model.
At https://huggingface.co/, compare the likes and downloads of the two models 'bert-base-uncased' and 'distilbert-base-uncased', and tell me which one is more popular.
At https://huggingface.co/datasets, find the 'imdb' dataset, open the Dataset Viewer, and check the label value of the first row of the train split.
At https://github.com/, search repositories related to 'web agent' sorted by most stars, filter by the Python language, and tell me the name and star count of the top repository.
At https://github.com/, open the README.md file in the huggingface/transformers repository and check its most recent commit message and author.
At https://github.com/, in the pytorch/pytorch repository, check the number of open issues labeled 'bug' and tell me the title of the most recently opened bug issue.
At https://paperswithcode.com/, on the Image Classification leaderboard for the ImageNet benchmark, tell me the difference in Top-1 Accuracy between the 1st and 2nd place models.
At https://pypi.org/, in the Release history of the 'requests' package, check the latest version number and the one before it, and tell me the difference in their release dates.
At https://arxiv.org/, search for papers with 'web agent' in the title submitted in 2024 or later, and tell me the title and first author of the most recently submitted paper.
